Name: Segub
Summary: Son of Hezron by the daughter of Machir, and father of Jair.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:21: Son of Hezron by the daughter of Machir, and father of Jair.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Segub stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
